title.zh: 贝莱德Q3财报：数字资产基金吸引79亿美元资金流入，数字资产规模796亿美元
title.en: 贝莱德Q3财报：数字资产基金吸引79亿美元资金流入，数字资产规模796亿美元

current_state.zh: BlackRock's Q3 earnings show its digital asset funds drew $7.9 billion of inflows in the quarter, flipping roughly $2.2 billion of first-half outflows, with digital asset AUM rising 63% quarter-over-quarter to $79.6 billion (including $22.9 billion from crypto price gains) while still running 23% below a year ago.
current_state.en: BlackRock's Q3 earnings show its digital asset funds drew $7.9 billion of inflows in the quarter, flipping roughly $2.2 billion of first-half outflows, with digital asset AUM rising 63% quarter-over-quarter to $79.6 billion (including $22.9 billion from crypto price gains) while still running 23% below a year ago.
